sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor's Degree in Quality Management, Engineering or related field with 6 years or more Quality Assurance / Quality Mangement role or equivalent Required
* Master's Degree in Quality Management, Engineering or related field with 4 years or more Quality Assurance / Quality Mangement role or equivalent Preferred
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Strong leadership, organizational, and problem solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Must be able to move freely without accommodation throughout the manufacturing facility
* Experience meeting Quality Management System requirements - ISO 9001, AS9100, or other equivalent industry standard.
* Experience with root cause analysis, ASQ, and containment best practices
* Visual Acuity
* Good Reading Skills
* Walking, Standing, Sitting
* Valid Driver's License for occasional travel
